SELECT DISTINCT su.id, su.username, su.real_name AS realName, su.phone, su.status, su.create_time AS createTime, ec.name AS categoryName FROM sys_user su INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.user_id = su.id INNER JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.id = sur.role_id AND sr.code = 'student' LEFT JOIN student_info si ON si.user_id = su.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exam_category ec ON ec.id = si.category_id WHERE su.deleted = 0
AND (su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY su.id

SELECT su.id, su.username, su.real_name AS realName, su.phone, su.status, su.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_user su WHERE su.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.id = sur.role_id WHERE sur.user_id = su.id AND sr.code = #{roleCode} )
ORDER BY su.id
